name: An Ace Walks Into a Bar
source:
Maya is lured away from a cozy night in with her girlfriend by the offer of a "girls' night out" with her older sister Lynn. Unfortunately for Maya, this family reunion doesn't go as well as she hoped...

An Ace Walks Into a Bar is a visual novel originally made for Ace Jam 2022.

[From [url=https://natashaluna.itch.io/an-ace-walks-into-a-bar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛雅因与姐姐林恩共度“女孩之夜”的提议而离开了与女友的舒适夜晚。不幸的是，对于玛雅来说，这次家庭团聚并没有像她希望的那样顺利……

《王牌走进酒吧》是一部最初为Ace Jam 2022制作的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://natashaluna.itch.io/an-ace-walks-into-a-bar]Itch.io[/url]]
